queries:
WITH obs AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM obs
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_above_average
FROM obs
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation,
         COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         cnt,
         CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS m FROM shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT m FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT m FROM avg_share);
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
n AS (
  SELECT 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_share FROM counts
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM n)) AS avg_excess_over_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM n);
